tasks.subject: Task 2: @views in polynomial assembly (Finding 5)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stop `generateMultivariatePolynomial` from materializing a length-n row copy per polynomial term-factor (measured 2.3×: 358 → 154 µs at 3D degree 3, n = 5000).

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/rbf.jl:398`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Pkg.test() passes
- [ ] The only change is the added `@views`

**Verify:** `using Pkg; Pkg.test()` via mcp__julia__julia_eval (env_path = repo) → all tests pass.

**Steps:** In `generateMultivariatePolynomial`, change `P[:, position] .*= points[var, :]` to `@views P[:, position] .*= points[var, :]` (exact diff in plan Task 2). Run Pkg.test(). Commit src/rbf.jl with the message given in the plan.

tasks.subject: Task 3: OhMyThreads dep, alias_A weight solves, tmap build loop (Finding 1)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Halve the build solve loop's allocations (LinearSolve's internal copy of every patch's kernel matrix) and migrate the loop to OhMyThreads tmap; measured together: 0.241 s / 41 % GC / 1047 MiB → 0.199 s / 28 % GC / 564 MiB with exactly identical weights.

**Files:**
- Modify: `Project.toml` (add OhMyThreads = "67456a42-1dca-4109-a031-0a68de7e3ad5" to deps, "0.8" to compat)
- Modify: `src/ScatteredInterpolation.jl:3` (add `using OhMyThreads: tmap, index_chunks`)
- Modify: `src/rbf.jl` (`_initsolve` gains `; aliasA = false` kwarg passing `alias_A = aliasA` to init; both `solveForWeights` methods pass `aliasA = true` for the A cache, cacheB stays default; `interpolate` copies A before solving only when `returnRBFmatrix = true` and returns that copy)
- Modify: `src/pum.jl:439-452` (build solve loop → `tmap(patchpoints) do idxs ... end` inside `withpinnedblas`, keep the narrowing comprehension)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Pkg.test() passes
- [ ] rippa.jl call sites keep default aliasA = false (gatedloocvscore reads opnorm(A,1) after solving)
- [ ] interpolate(...; returnRBFmatrix = true) returns the assembled un-factorized matrix (spot-check: symmetric, unit diagonal for Multiquadratic)

**Verify:** Pkg.test() via mcp__julia__julia_eval → pass; returnRBFmatrix spot-check from plan Task 3 Step 6 prints `symmetric: true | diag ones: true`.

**Steps:** Exact code for every edit is in plan Task 3 Steps 1-5. Then test (Step 6) and commit (Step 7).

```json:metadata

```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Threaded patch assignment (Finding 3)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rewrite `assignpatches` to batch cell centers into one matrix and chunk the range queries across threads (standalone measured 49 → 22-34 ms; verified identical output at 3D and 6D).

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/pum.jl:74-99` (`assignpatches`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Pkg.test() passes
- [ ] No Threads.@threads in the new code; tmap over index_chunks(1:ncell; n = 8 * Threads.nthreads()), each task returning its own chunk's inrange results; reduce(vcat, parts); filter non-empty, sort! in place, gather kept centers

**Verify:** Pkg.test() via mcp__julia__julia_eval → all tests pass.

**Steps:** Replace the whole function body with the complete code in plan Task 4 Step 1 (builds `allcenters::Matrix{T}(undef, D, ncell)` from `centerof`, drops the per-cell `collect`). Test, commit with the plan's message.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Evaluate restructure (Finding 2)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Thread the candidate query, build exact-size per-patch buffers (count-then-fill), migrate pass 2 to tmap, and drop two forced copies — measured together: evaluate 0.145 → 0.086 s (3D), 3.27 → 1.90 s (6D), outputs bit-identical.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/pum.jl:459-541` (`evaluate(::PartitionOfUnityInterpolant, ...)`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Pkg.test() passes
- [ ] Pass 1 candidate query threaded via tmap over index_chunks; per-patch buffers count-then-fill with resize! trim; no push! growth
- [ ] convert(Matrix{T}, ...) used instead of the Matrix{T}(...) constructor for the query matrix and the fallback branch
- [ ] Pass 3 scatter and normalization logic unchanged

**Verify:** Pkg.test() via mcp__julia__julia_eval → all tests pass (PUM tests cover exactness at nodes, matrix samples, mixed eltypes, uncovered-query fallback).

**Steps:** Replace the whole evaluate method with the complete code in plan Task 5 Step 1 (candidate counts are an upper bound → resize! after the guarded fill; pass 2 skips the Matrix{Tout} conversion when eltype already matches since reshape does not copy). Test, commit with the plan's message.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Stored bounding box in addpoints!, tmap re-solve loop (Finding 4)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stop addpoints! from scanning all stored points for the bounding box on every call (0.69 ms of a 2.43 ms 10-point insert at n = 100k), and migrate its re-solve loop to tmap per the threading policy.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/pum.jl` — `PartitionOfUnityInterpolant` struct (insert `lo::Vector{T}` / `hi::Vector{T}` fields after `samples::S`), the constructor call in `interpolate` (pass `vec(minimum(pts, dims = 2))`, `vec(maximum(pts, dims = 2))` in the new positions), and `addpoints!` (use `itp.lo`/`itp.hi`; re-solve via tmap with sequential write-back)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Pkg.test() passes (existing tests cover out-of-bbox rejection and post-insert exactness)
- [ ] addpoints! no longer computes minimum/maximum over itp.points
- [ ] Re-solve loop uses tmap; results written back by index sequentially

**Verify:** Pkg.test() via mcp__julia__julia_eval → all tests pass.

**Steps:** Exact code for all four edits in plan Task 6 Steps 1-4. Test, commit with the plan's message.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/pum.jl"], "verifyCommand": "Pkg.test() via mcp__julia__julia_eval", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Pkg.test() passes", "no min/max scan in addpoints!", "re-solve loop via tmap"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```
